description: Presumed fraud risk that revenue is recorded for sales that did not occur, to meet growth expectations (revenue up 15.4% on the prior year).
Risk that sales invoiced before 30 June 2026 are recognised although control of the goods passes to customers after year end; June revenue is 12.5% of the annual total.
Risk that bank balances recorded in the general ledger do not exist or are overstated at 30 June 2026.
